SpaceSystem.species:
ci_slag Cinder mineral 44 4 1 Vitrous Slag | Rift glass, quenched in seconds. Trapped bubbles still hold the original atmosphere.
ci_sulf Cinder mineral 43 3 0.9 Sulphur Bloom | Vents deposit it faster than the heat can destroy it. Barely a mineral. Barely stable.
ci_ember Cinder flora 37 2 0.6 Ember Lichen | Not a plant. A thermophile colony that metabolises the rock it sits on.
ci_crawl Cinder fauna 116 0 0.8 Slag Crawler | Armoured, blind, and running an internal temperature that should not permit chemistry.
te_reed Tethys flora 38 6 0.8 Pale Reed | Hollow-stemmed, wind-pollinated, and the dominant ground cover of the northern flats.
te_cap Tethys flora 45 2 0.7 Lantern Cap | Fruiting body glows on a 40-second cycle. Nothing here is known to see in that band.
te_pine Tethys flora 49 3 1 Kestra Spire | A conifer analogue whose rings record every flood the Talari have recorded, and several they have not.
te_iron Tethys mineral 42 2 1.1 Banded Ironstone | Layered oxide. Proof this world once had far more free oxygen than it does now.
te_ice Tethys mineral 44 2 1.2 Clathrate Pocket | Methane locked in a water lattice. Vents when disturbed. Excellent propellant feedstock.
te_graze Tethys fauna 135 0 1 Flat Grazer | Herd animal. Six legs, no forward-facing eyes, and an alarm call you feel before you hear.
te_skim Tethys fauna 108 0 1.4 Ridge Skimmer | Glides the thermal line along ridge crests. Will not approach a lit helmet.
ve_ice Vell mineral 43 5 1.1 Blue Ice Column | Compressed for long enough to squeeze out every bubble. Rings when struck.
ve_reg Vell mineral 42 3 1.6 Impact Regolith | Glass beads and shattered anorthosite. The record of every strike this moon ever took.
ve_frond Vell flora 37 2 0.5 Rime Frond | Grows in vacuum, in the dark, at 100 kelvin. It should not exist. It is thriving.
ve_strider Vell fauna 112 0 0.9 Rime Strider | Crosses the crater floors in the dark, grazing rime fronds. Its heat signature is barely warmer than the ice it walks on.
os_bone Ossuary mineral 42 4 1.4 Chalk Spar | Calcite, laid down in water this world has not had for a very long time.
os_dust Ossuary mineral 44 3 0.9 Ferric Dust | Fine enough to hold a static charge. It gets into every seal you own.
os_stalk Ossuary flora 51 1 0.6 Grey Stalk | Desiccated but not dead. Rehydrates in minutes if you are careless with your water.
os_husk Ossuary fauna 136 0 0.9 Dust Husk | Moves once every few minutes. Long-lived, low-energy, and aware of you.
ho_bulb Hollow flora 45 3 0.9 Deeplight Bulb | Photosynthesises by its own light. The energy budget only closes if it is also feeding.
ho_vine Hollow flora 38 3 1.1 Pressure Vine | Stiffened by internal pressure alone. Cut one and the whole plant collapses.
ho_crys Hollow mineral 43 3 1.3 Abyssal Crystal | Grew under this atmosphere. It is under enormous strain and it is holding.
ho_drift Hollow fauna 114 0 2.2 Mist Drifter | Rides the overcast, filter-feeding. It is the largest living thing in the system.
ne_shard Nemesis mineral 44 4 1.2 Null Shard | Absorbs across every band you can measure. The sample reads colder than its surroundings.
ne_watcher Nemesis fauna 133 0 1.1 Pale Watcher | It keeps its distance and keeps facing you. The signal is loudest when one is near.
